description.value:
This humble-looking silver necklace is made of interlinked silver rings, each shaped like a stylized silver tongue. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive]] and to your Perception DCs to notice spoken lies.

Activate—Cloud Judgment r (concentrate, mental)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You catch a creature in a lie

Effect The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:30] saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is immune to your other effects that would compel them to tell the truth for 24 hours.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is flustered. For the next minute, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} and must succeed at a flat check with a DC equal to 5 + its stupefied value whenever it attempts to lie or omit the truth.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} for 10 minutes.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
